raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since 2026-01-15 the v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC, while legacy and all history use America/Chicago local time. As a result, v2 transactions are shifted 6 hours later (CST in January), which pushes evening transactions into 00:00-06:00 and onto the next txn_date (the 31 spurious rows on 2026-01-19). The fix converts v2 timestamps from UTC to Chicago local time in silver, so txn_ts and txn_date are consistent with legacy; gold tables are rebuilt from the corrected silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
